from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class HousingAuthorizationEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a report's Table 1b."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report containing this data, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    value_thousands: float | None = Field(description="The authorization count in thousands of units")
    region: Literal["Midwest"] | None = Field(description="The US Census region")
    adjustment_status: str | None = Field(description="Indicates if data is seasonally adjusted or not")
    
class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all data points extracted from the document collection."""
    housing_data: list[HousingAuthorizationEntry]
